Maximum tier count comes from event template `tierLimits`.

- `free` -> `tierLimits.free`
- `premium` -> `tierLimits.premium`

Fallback limits used by backend logic if template values are missing:

- Free: `0`
- Premium: `2`
- Pro: `5`

## Validation behavior

- Adding tiers beyond your plan limit is blocked.
- Save/create calls are rejected if tier count exceeds plan limit.
- Inputs normalize numeric values to non-negative numbers.

Use &pN and &t to map command arguments before AST evaluation.

Argument placeholders are resolved before Special Functions parsing.

## Placeholders

- `&pN` -> argument position (`&p1`, `&p2`, `&p3`, ...)
- `&t` -> tail text (all remaining arguments from the current max position)

## Example

Input command:

```text
!demo alpha beta gamma delta
```

Template:

```text
first=&p1 second=&p2 rest=&t
```

Output:

```text
first=alpha second=beta rest=gamma delta
```

## Important rule

Do not create a new `&pN` after `&t` in the same template.

Invalid pattern example:

```text
&p1 &t &p2
```

This returns parser error:

```text
cannot create new &pN after &t
```

## Notes

- Placeholders are plain text replacement before AST expressions run.
- If an argument position is missing, `&pN` resolves to empty text.
- If no remaining arguments exist, `&t` resolves to empty text.
